mapper.select: SELECT stock_unit AS stockUnit, stock_units_per_sale_unit AS stockUnitsPerSaleUnit FROM xsy_product_sku_stock_conversion WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND sale_unit = #{saleUnit} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY stock_unit
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_product_sku_stock_conversion (sku_id, sale_unit, stock_unit, stock_units_per_sale_unit, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{saleUnit}, #{stockUnit}, #{factor}, #{operator}, #{operator}) ON CONFLICT (sku_id, sale_unit, stock_unit) WHERE deleted = FALSE DO UPDATE SET stock_units_per_sale_unit = EXCLUDED.stock_units_per_sale_unit, version = xsy_product_sku_stock_conversion.version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
